serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Eh… Do you really want to go there?
You: I think it’s best to explain everything to her, so you can come to mutual understanding or whatever.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You almost sounded smart, but you just had to add ‘or whatever’ at the end, didn’t you?
Ugh, I think he got mad at me.
'Nun' Shanice: Just spit it out Priestcan. The faster you say it the faster we can move on.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: The thing is… Shanice, you are a big fan of the Church, we all can see it, but being a fan does not mean you can be a part of it. 
'Nun' Shanice: What do you mean? 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Faith isn’t about liking culture, music or Church’s technology. It’s about believing in one true God and you lack that.
'Nun' Shanice: Believing in God? 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceThinking
'Nun' Shanice: Isn’t this kinda wacky in this day and age? 
…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
You: So…{{wi}} I have another question.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
'Nun' Shanice: Hey! You guys are already changing the subject?!
You: I wanted to ask about the new pope. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
